# LOGIC

Custom routing written in Python: sends each entity to one of several outgoing links by your own rule when chance or a condition is not enough.

Routes an entity through a user-supplied, plain (non-BaseProcess) class defined in nagasim.core.custom_logic, or first in the module the caller passes as `run_model(logic=...)`. The class only needs an `execute(self, entity, ctx) -> int` method returning the outgoing link index; `execute(self, entity)` (no ctx) is also accepted.

Family: control. Python builder: `m.logic(...)`.

## Typical uses

Use LOGIC when a routing rule is too complex for [DECIDE](decide.md): a rule that needs loops, several attributes, a lookup or state kept between entities. You write the rule as a small Python class, and the block uses the number it returns as the index of the outgoing link.

## Behaviour and rules

The class needs an `execute(self, entity, ctx)` method that returns the link index. A method `execute(self, entity)` without `ctx` is also accepted. The model file only names the class in `logic_class`. The class is looked up first in the module the caller passes with `run_model(logic=...)` or `naga run --logic`, then in the default module `custom_logic`.

A model file cannot name a module or a path, so a file alone cannot make the engine run Python. The caller chooses the module. A class that neither module has stops the run with an error.

A new instance of the class is created for every entity. Anything the rule must remember between entities therefore belongs in model variables or on the context, not in the instance. The returned index must be a valid link of the block, or the run stops with an error. The block takes no time.

## Ports

- Inputs: any number of incoming links.
- Outputs: several, one for each branch; the block picks the link by its index at run time.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Required | Quantity | Unit key | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `logic_class` | str | `'SampleLogic'` |  |  |  | Name of a class in nagasim.core.custom_logic implementing execute(entity, ctx) -> int. |

## Statistics

Every run fills `system` and `entity_summary` (see the [KPI reference](../kpis.md)). The example below also fills:

| Frame | Columns |
|---|---|
| `material_flow_summary` | `Run`, `From`, `To`, `Entities` |

## Problem codes

A check of the model reports these about this block:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_VIEWER_MODEL` | A model cannot be shared as a browser viewer as it is: it holds agent Python, a LOGIC block, something a plugin registered, a data source that was not frozen into the copy, or it is too large. |

## Example

The snippet seeds itself; its output is from a run made when this page was generated.

```python
from nagasim import build as nb

m = nb.Model(time_limit=100)
logic = m.logic()                              # the stock SampleLogic: always link 0
m.create(distribution=nb.Constant(value=2)) >> logic
logic >> m.delay(distribution=nb.Constant(value=1)) >> m.dispose()
logic >> m.dispose()

results = m.run(seed=1)
print(int(results.kpi("system/Total Entities Completed")), "entities, all sent down link 0")
```

```text
50 entities, all sent down link 0
```
